summary:
Revised Implementation Plan for POC-001: Product Signal Intelligence OS.
Incorporates:
1. Capability-based architecture (products declare capability profiles rather than hardcoding 10 stages).
2. Product vs Opportunity distinction (Product is the entity; Opportunity is the commercial thesis, channel, and economics).
3. 9-step disciplined progression with zero bundling: Step 1 (Audit completed), Step 2 (Fix existing state & connectivity), Step 3 (Product & Opportunity abstraction), Step 4 (Product Universe & Capability System), Step 5 (Opportunity Discovery), Step 6 (Multi-Product & Relationships), Step 7 (Persistence & Reproducibility), Step 8 (Research Agents), Step 9 (Strategy & Capital Allocation).
4. Frozen Financial Core (FINANCIAL_ENGINE_SPEC v1.0.0-FROZEN) invariance with ₹0 calculation drift.
